verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes a public API (via JS SDK, API keys), webhooks for checkout status, and an official MCP server/Agent Toolkit that let an AI agent programmatically interact with SumUp to manage accounts, create checkouts, and process payments — laying groundwork for agent-driven financial workflows. However, there is no direct evidence of a dedicated transactions-list or payouts endpoint that an agent could pull to reconcile daily takings into a ledger; the docs mention only checkout creation, refunds, and status-change webhooks, not payout reporting or ledger reconciliation. missing for 10: explicit transactions/payouts API endpoints, evidence of an agent workflow pulling payout data into a ledger, reconciliation-specific documentation or use case.
